Regional Technical Implementation Unit for Women and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD-PPA, is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
7. Forum for the Protection of Violence Victims, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.
8. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 years, including a child in the womb.
10. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
11. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband and wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
12. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers who reside in that household.
13. Guardian is a person or body who in fact exercises parental authority over a child.
14. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of violence victims.
15. Judicial body is the general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
18. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.

5­

19. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
20. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Buton Regency.
21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
22. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will, is or has occurred.
24. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in matters and in the manner regulated by law with a request to be examined and decided by a judge in a court session.
25. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to act according to law against a person who has harmed him/her civilly.
26. Safe House is a shelter for victims during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
27. NUMBER 6 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CHAPTER VIII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 38

1. The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in the region.

2. Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. coordination;

b. guidance;

c. education and training; and

d. monitoring and evaluation.

3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.

{4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.

5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be conducted in accordance with laws and regulations.

6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d shall be conducted periodically.

CHAPTERX

COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

Article 40

1. The community participates in the organization of protection for Victims.

2. Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:

a. establishing family partners at the sub-district/village level by the community;

b. establishing women and children protection units within community organizations;

18­

c. conducting socialization of women's and children's rights independently;

d. providing first aid to victims; and  e. reporting to the competent authority if violence against victims occurs in their environment.

(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph ( 1) shall be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.

CHAPTER VII

INFORMATION/REPORTING SYSTEM

Article 37

( 1) The Regent implements an information/reporting system for the protection of women and children victims of violence.

(2) The information/reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be organized in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 10

Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits whether material or immaterial; and/or
c. any form of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

Article 9

Neglect as referred to in Article 5 letter d is caused by:
a. acts that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of the child properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care;
b. acts of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after the child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care;
c. acts that neglect a person within the household scope, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or
d. acts that result in economic dependence by means of restricting and/or prohibiting proper work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Article 25

(1) Legal aid services as referred to in Article 20 letter e constitute services provided to assist victims in undergoing the judicial process.

2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. legal consultation that includes information regarding the rights of victims and the judicial process;
b. assistance to victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court hearings and helping victims to fully describe the violence they experienced;
c. coordination with fellow law enforcers, volunteer assistants, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should; and
d. reporting on case developments.

Article 26

1. Victim repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in Article 20 letter f aim to return victims to their families and social environment.
2. Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out after the implementation of socialization related to the rights of women as victims.
3. Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Government in coordination with:
a. the Provincial Regional Government;
b. other Regional Governments; and
c. related government and non-government agencies and institutions.

NUMBER 6 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; andc. empower women victims of violence.

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3

Protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; andc. empower women victims of violence.

Article4 The scope of regulation of the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention, service, and empowerment efforts for victims of violence in the Region.

Article 25

(1) Legal aid services as referred to in Article 20 letter e constitute services provided to assist victims in undergoing the judicial process.

2. Services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. legal consultation that includes information regarding the rights of victims and the judicial process;
b. assistance to victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court hearings and helping victims to fully describe the violence they experienced;
c. coordination with fellow law enforcers, volunteer assistants, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should; and
d. reporting on case developments.

Article 32

1. The Regional Government and the community are obliged to fulfill the rights of child victims of violence.
(2) Forms of fulfillment of the rights of child victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include fulfillment of the basic rights of children according to their needs.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CHAPTER VIII

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 38

1. The Regional Government conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in the region.

2. Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. coordination;

b. guidance;

c. education and training; and

d. monitoring and evaluation.

3. Coordination as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a covers aspects related to planning and implementation.

{4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.

5. Education and training as referred to in paragraph (2) letter c shall be conducted in accordance with laws and regulations.

6. Monitoring and evaluation as referred to in paragraph (2) letter d shall be conducted periodically.

Article 3

Protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; andc. empower women victims of violence.

Article4 The scope of regulation of the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention, service, and empowerment efforts for victims of violence in the Region.

b. coercion, including a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

a. spiritual guidance to victims; and
b. psychological recovery of victims.

Physical violence as referred to in Article 5 letter a is caused by acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and/or causing death.

NUMBER 6 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

d. monitoring and evaluation.

{4) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2) letter b covers aspects related to planning, implementation, procedures, financing, quality, control and supervision.

Article 25

b. assistance to victims at the investigation, prosecution, and examination levels in court hearings and helping victims to fully describe the violence they experienced;
c. coordination with fellow law enforcers, volunteer assistants, and social workers so that the judicial process proceeds as it should; and
d. reporting on case developments.

Article 26

3. Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Government in coordination with:
a. the Provincial Regional Government;
b. other Regional Governments; and
c. related government and non-government agencies and institutions.

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY

NUMBER 6 OF 2021

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 26

1. Victim repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in Article 20 letter f aim to return victims to their families and social environment.
2. Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out after the implementation of socialization related to the rights of women as victims.
3. Repatriation and social reintegration services as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by the Regional Government in coordination with:
a. the Provincial Regional Government;
b. other Regional Governments; and
c. related government and non-government agencies and institutions.

b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and
c. capital assistance.

Article 11

Other violence as referred to in Article 5 letter f is caused by:
a. threats of violence, including any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and
b. coercion, including a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

The State has an obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights so their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so minimum services for victims of violence are needed.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, financing, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Regional Technical Implementation Unit for Women and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD-PPA, is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
7. Forum for the Protection of Violence Victims, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.
8. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 years, including a child in the womb.
10. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
11. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband and wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
12. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers who reside in that household.
13. Guardian is a person or body who in fact exercises parental authority over a child.
14. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of violence victims.
15. Judicial body is the general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice.

21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
22. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.

25. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to act according to law against a person who has harmed him/her civilly.
26. Safe House is a shelter for victims during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers of perpetrators.
